name: 68178 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68178 (Omaha) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68178 (Omaha) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
